text:
Alex: Morning team — quick sync on the Orbitsync initiative. Customer wants a private deployment with a 200 qps burst SLA at launch. Need runtime/infra/security input on sequencing and minimum launch gates. @sam @jin @rupert any red flags?
Sam: Quick clarifying Q — is the traffic mostly long-context chat or short queries?
Maria: Short back-and-forth, typical ~512 token sessions.
Sam: That helps. We can probably meet token latency targets with batching + prefix cache, but bursts need prewarm. I need infra commit for a GPU pool for canary day.
Jin: Security note: SSO + KMS integration should be doable but timeline depends on KMS access approval. We also need a named owner for compliance docs. @maria can you own that?
Rupert: Infra: we can provide the dedicated pool but need ~2 weeks to carve resources + VPC peering/network setup. Also need cloud routing coordination. I can add 2 infra engineers the week of May 8.
Carla: Product perspective: customer prefers VPC, but will accept hosted fallback for an initial pilot if we commit to a VPC timeline. Is that acceptable?
Alex: They prefer VPC but will accept hosted fallback for pilot if we guarantee VPC delivery timeline and SLA on latency/data residency.
Sam: One technical detail — which model variant for launch? fp16 gives ~20% lower latency vs full precision quantized 4-bit has different tradeoffs.
Maria: Customer requires high fidelity for the pilot, start with fp16. We can test quantized options in Dedicated after baseline.
Sam: Noted. Also recommend canary split + automatic fallback policy in case of regression. Example rollout pseudocode: 
```
if median_latency > 150ms or error_rate > 1%:
  route -> hosted-fallback
  notify #incidents
```
Alex: Draft launch checklist: 
- model variant validated (fp16)
- infra pool provisioned + VPC peering requested
- security sign-off (KMS + SSO)
- E2E test with customer sample dataset
- canary traffic + rollback policy in place
- run load test at 2x expected peak
Jin: Add: audit log retention & access control policy.
Rupert: Add: observability dashboard for token-level cost and latency per route.
Carla: I'll own customer comms and timeline. Tentative pilot: June 15, GA: June 29. Can infra hit June 15 for pilot?
Rupert: Pilot on June 15 is tight but achievable if infra starts resource carve this week. Need final model size + expected RPS by Friday.
Sam: I'll run perf baseline on fp16 and share numbers by Thu.
Maria: I'll send sample dataset + agreed SLOs to the team today and follow up on compliance owner.
Alex: Please react with ✅ if you accept owners/timeline or call out blockers.
deploy-bot: Deployment window noted. Meeting scheduled: https://meet.link/xyz on 2024-05-02 16:00.
Sam: ✅
Rupert: ✅ (unless KMS access is delayed)
Jin: ✅ (assigning compliance docs owner to @maria)
Maria: ✅
Carla: ✅
Alex: Thanks all — I'll update the initiative doc and create a shared checklist in the console.
